descriptions.notStarted: I have passed all of #p2101011#'s tests. Now all that I got to do is become a member of the Sand Bandits, right? I better go to #b#p2101011##k and talk to him about it.
descriptions.inProgress: #p2101011# said if I am a true member, even if I have a lot, I shouldn't be too caught up by it, and use that wealth to help the people at #m260000000#, and immediately asked me if I can fork over #b10000 mesos#k for the members of the Sand Bandits.
descriptions.completed: It took me a while to get that much money, but I donated 10,000 mesos to the residents of #m260000000#. That's when he told me I have now passed all of his test. That also means I have to pass other peoples' tests, too. Come to think of it, that wall of secret mentioned bow and arrows, iron hammer, and dagger.
